name: Lüju Monü Yu Ta de Biye Keti
original_name: 旅居魔女与她的毕业课题
source:
Play as a wise woman, help your neighbors, and they will help you in return. Fight alongside your closest friend to deal with the beasts threatening the village. Uncover the secrets of magic through your journey, and you might even have a chance to confront your inner demons.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3816020/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
扮演一个聪明的女人，帮助你的邻居，他们也会帮助你作为回报。与你最亲密的朋友并肩作战，应对威胁村庄的野兽。在你的旅程中揭开魔法的秘密，你甚至可能有机会面对内心的恶魔。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3816020/]Steam[/url]]
